name: cn.dianyinhuoban.szg.mvp.machine.view.BatchTransferActivity
description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK displays the batch machine-transfer form. Its instructions describe selecting machines between entered start and end numbers and warn that cashback machines must be handled one at a time.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes the batch machine-transfer form.
